title: Sid Can Not See the Cat
lines: Sid can not see the cat.
"Is it in the tub?" said Mom.
Sid did not see it in the tub.
"Is it in the bin?" said Mom.
Sid can see a mop and a big bag.
Sid can tip the bag. A cat got up!
The cat sat on Sid. It can nap.

questions.listenFor: In the big bag. The story says it. If your child says the tub, read the line about the bag again together.

questions.ask: How did Sid find the cat?
questions.listenFor: He tipped the bag over and the cat got up. Listen for Sid doing the tipping - Mom gave ideas, but Sid did the looking.

questions.ask: Where else could Sid have looked for the cat?
questions.listenFor: Any spot. Mom named the tub and the bin; the bag is what worked. Ask what makes a good hiding spot.
